# Cloudberry Fen for Dark Reader. Cloudberry tint of Fen: dark, neutrals leaned toward cloudberry (base #553524).
# Generated by build.mjs from src/ports/dark-reader.txt. Do not edit ports/dark-reader/.
#
# Dark Reader takes its colours as settings, not as a file, so there is nothing to install:
# type the three values below into its Colors panel. Click the Dark Reader icon, then See all
# options > Colors (the Colors panel is the redesigned popup; on desktop turn it on once with
# Dev Tools > Enable design prototype). Set the theme to Dark first, because the panel edits
# the colours of the current mode. Paste Background and Text, then set Selection from Auto to
# Custom and paste Selection. There is no save button. Typing a Background or Text value also
# resets Brightness, Contrast, Sepia and Grayscale to 100/100/0/0, so set those afterwards.
# Darkberry Fen, Mire and Blackwater are also offered by name in Dark Reader's Color Scheme
# list once darkreader/darkreader carries them; that list sets Background and Text only.
#
# Needs Dark Reader 4.9.9 or newer for the three fields (Selection arrived there); the Color
# Scheme list arrived in 4.9.40. Checked against the source of 4.9.133. Only the Dynamic
# engine, Dark Reader's default, reads these colours: it remaps every page colour between
# Background and Text. Filter, Filter+ and Static ignore them. No environment is needed.
#
# Dark flavours only: a Dark Reader scheme has one dark half, and Wisp is not offered as the
# light half because Dark Reader's light mode recolours already-light pages toward the text
# colour (black chrome turns plum, grey text turns berry) rather than giving Wisp's look.
# Left unset: Scrollbar stays on Default, the browser's own scrollbar, drawn dark because
# Dark Reader sets color-scheme: dark. Custom would paint the thumb in one colour and the
# track 0.4 lower in HSL lightness, which no role describes. Brightness, Contrast, Sepia,
# Grayscale and the font are the user's own.
#
# Host-owned pairing: with a custom Selection, Dark Reader paints selected text white when
# the Selection colour's HSL lightness is under 0.5 and black otherwise, whatever Text is.
# ui.selection is under 0.5 in every dark flavour (the build checks it), so selected text is
# white: 7.99 / 11.57 / 13.41 on ui.selection for Fen / Mire / Blackwater.
#
# Differs from Catppuccin (catppuccin/dark-reader, main at 07a9b7f1): Selection is
# ui.selection, berry mixed into the background, not surface2; the light flavour is left out.
Background = #553524
Text = #f8e6dd
Selection = #73463e
